## GraphBuilder.graph() method

The declared graph, with its routes, for `createRunner`<!-- -->, `run` and `checkGraph`<!-- -->. Its type  carries every (base, provider) pair the routes join.

**Signature:**

```typescript
graph<Rs extends readonly Route<keyof E & string, ProviderBase>[]>(...routes: Rs): Graph<E, Ctx, Meta, Rs[number]>;
```
